text:
alyssa: Quick follow-up on the cross-region TLS flaps last night. Root cause: SNI fallback path in LB config sent traffic to cert-incompatible backend. Need owners for fix + guardrails so this doesn't recur.

mario: saw tls handshake spikes at ~02:14 UTC and retries amplified traffic to fallback pool. I'll own disabling the fallback and adding a feature flag.

jia: I'll own canary + predeploy checks. Plan: lb-canary route 0.5% in eu/us-east, run SNI matrix (valid/missing/malformed) for 24h. Add CI job `verify_sni_matrix.sh`.

ops-lead: action list: 1) mario: PR to disable fallback + tests + feature flag (due 2026-06-05). 2) jia: canary route + playbook updates (due 2026-06-09). 3) sre-oncall: synthetic + alert (due 2026-06-06). 4) alyssa: customer impact + comms (due 2026-06-07).

sre-oncall: I'll add temporary Pager when TLS handshake failures > 40 in 5m for cross-region hop pattern. Synthetic: /observability/synthetics/sni-crossregion every 10m, alert >2 failures in 6 checks.

mario: opening PR now (link posted in parent doc). Adding `DEBUG_LB_HANDSHAKE=true` gated logging and small CI script: `infra/tools/verify_sni.sh` (openssl s_client checks).

jia: will add circuit-breaker and auto-rollback during canary: 0.5% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health gates. Fail criteria include synthetic or handshake alert.

alyssa: add recurrence note in PM: link to prior Jan incident and list recurring class (sni-mismatch+retries). Add guardrails: canaries, feature-flags, synthetics.

ops-lead: update runbooks/lb-tls-issues.md with rollback commands and checklist. Reconvene 2026-06-06 18:00 UTC for status.

incident-bot: postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-06-lb-tls-sni-summary. Severity: P2.
